mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , hkd.hkd_cur AS hkdCur , hkd.hkd_gijun_rt AS hkdGijunRt , usd.usd_cur AS usdCur , usd.usd_gijun_rt AS usdGijunRt , gbp.gbp_cur AS gbpCur , gbp.gbp_gijun_rt AS gbpGijunRt , vnd.vnd_cur AS vndCur , vnd.vnd_gijun_rt AS vndGijunRt , sgd.sgd_cur AS sgdCur , sgd.sgd_gijun_rt AS sgdGijunRt , CASE WHEN t1.holi_gb IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 255 END AS fontColor , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SZX9DT t1 , (SELECT ta.currency AS hkd_cur , ta.gijun_ymd AS hkd_ymd , ta.gijun_rt AS hkd_gijun_rt FROM SYX1HY ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.currency = 'HKD' AND ta.gijun_ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) hkd , (SELECT ta.currency AS usd_cur , ta.gijun_ymd AS usd_ymd , ta.gijun_rt AS usd_gijun_rt FROM SYX1HY ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.currency = 'USD' AND ta.gijun_ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) usd , (SELECT ta.currency AS gbp_cur , ta.gijun_ymd AS gbp_ymd , ta.gijun_rt AS gbp_gijun_rt FROM SYX1HY ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.currency = 'GBP' AND ta.gijun_ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) gbp , (SELECT ta.currency AS vnd_cur , ta.gijun_ymd AS vnd_ymd , ta.gijun_rt AS vnd_gijun_rt FROM SYX1HY ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.currency = 'VND' AND ta.gijun_ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) vnd , (SELECT ta.currency AS sgd_cur , ta.gijun_ymd AS sgd_ymd , ta.gijun_rt AS sgd_gijun_rt FROM SYX1HY ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.currency = 'SGD' AND ta.gijun_ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) sgd WHERE t1.ymd BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND hkd.hkd_ymd(+) = t1.ymd AND usd.usd_ymd(+) = t1.ymd AND gbp.gbp_ymd(+) = t1.ymd AND vnd.vnd_ymd(+) = t1.ymd AND sgd.sgd_ymd(+) = t1.ymd ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SYX1HY t USING DUAL ON (t.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t.GIJUN_YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.CURRENCY = #{currency}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.GIJUN_RT = #{gijunRt} , t.IP_YMD = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CORP_GR, GIJUN_YMD, CURRENCY, GIJUN_RT, IP_YMD, BM_VAL) VALUES (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{currency}, #{gijunRt}, SYSDATE, NULL)
